{
  "agentType": "database",
  "summary": {
    "overallRisk": "critical",
    "topConcern": "Serverless connection exhaustion + unsafe checkout writes will fail under moderate concurrency.",
    "criticalCount": 2,
    "warningCount": 2,
    "infoCount": 0
  },
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "DB-1",
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "connection_pool",
      "title": "PrismaClient not singleton in production",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/lib/prisma.ts",
        "route": "global prisma client instantiation",
        "function": "module init (prisma export)",
        "pattern": "globalForPrisma.prisma is assigned only when NODE_ENV !== 'production'; new PrismaClient() created otherwise",
        "lines": "L1-L40"
      },
      "impact": "On serverless (Vercel/Next) each cold start/instance creates a new DB connection; will exhaust DB connections at low concurrency (~50-200 concurrent requests).",
      "fix": "Use a production-safe singleton or a pooled proxy (PgBouncer/Prisma Data Proxy) and cache PrismaClient in globalThis in all envs."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-2",
      "severity": "critical",
      "category": "transaction",
      "title": "Checkout flow mutates coupon and order without atomic transaction",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/app/api/checkout/create-order/route.ts",
        "route": "/api/checkout/create-order",
        "function": "POST",
        "pattern": "Reads coupon -> updates coupon.quantity (await prisma.coupon.update) then proceeds to create user/order and multiple per-item updates/creates without wrapping whole checkout in a single transaction; item upserts and deletes are individual awaited calls inside loops",
        "lines": "L1-L300"
      },
      "impact": "Race conditions and partial commits: concurrent checkouts can overspend coupon.quantity or leave order/items partially created if a later step fails, causing financial/fulfillment inconsistencies under moderate load (~100+ concurrent checkouts).",
      "fix": "Wrap coupon decrement + order creation/upserts in a single DB transaction with conditional atomic decrement (WHERE quantity > 0) or use SELECT...FOR UPDATE pattern."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-3",
      "severity": "warning",
      "category": "query_pattern",
      "title": "Unbounded product list queries (no pagination)",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "src/app/api/products/route.ts",
        "route": "/api/products (GET)",
        "function": "GET",
        "pattern": "prisma.product.findMany() used with include and orderBy but no take/skip or cursor pagination",
        "lines": "L1-L80"
      },
      "impact": "Endpoint returns entire products table on every request; as products grow this causes heavy reads and increased response times on high-traffic pages (homepage, shop), causing degraded UX at thousands of users.",
      "fix": "Add cursor/offset pagination (take/skip or cursor-based) and allow caching; restrict fields returned."
    },
    {
      "id": "DB-4",
      "severity": "warning",
      "category": "missing_index",
      "title": "Missing indexes on high-traffic filter/sort columns",
      "evidence": {
        "file": "prisma/schema.prisma",
        "route": "schema Product and queries",
        "function": "Product model",
        "pattern": "Product model lacks indexes for category, isBestSeller/isNewArrival/isActive and createdAt (ORDER BY). Several API routes filter by category or boolean flags.",
        "lines": "L1-L220"
      },
      "impact": "Filters and ORDER BY on unindexed columns will cause full table scans once products/orders grow (~100k+ rows), degrading queries from ms to seconds and increasing DB CPU.",
      "fix": "Add indexes for frequent filters: @@index([category]), indexes on isActive/isBestSeller/isNewArrival, and consider index on createdAt for sorting."
    }
  ],
  "scale": {
    "10k_users": "failure",

    "1M_users": "failure"
  },

}
